Cosmetic arithmetic-order note (not a logic error, but worth pinning for a byte-exact port): EAST (8AB5) computes $66 = $62 + $0070 then ADC $2E. WEST (8BC4) computes $66 = $62 + $2E then SBC $0070 (vel added BEFORE feeler subtracted). SW (8FC1) computes $66 = $62 - $0070 then ADC $2E. All are arithmetically equivalent to base +/- $70 + vel, but the actual instruction order/carry handling differs per handler; the spec's generic '$62 +/- $0070 + $2E' is accurate in result.
